source_quote: the College of Business Administration at Rafik Hariri University offers a Minor in Business
answer: The CBA offers a Minor in Business Administration for non-business students, giving a fundamental foundation in business administration with an entrepreneurial flavor.

source_quote: Declare a Minor in Business Administration by completing the Minor Declaration
answer: To complete the Business Administration minor, a student must submit the Minor Declaration Form, obtain approval from their college dean and the CBA dean, keep a minor CGPA of at least 70%, and complete 18 business credits.

source_quote: BECN 301 or Microeconomics or 3 Junior Standing
answer: Business Administration minor courses (18 credits): BACC 205 Financial Accounting, BADM 490 Entrepreneurship, BECN 301 Microeconomics or BECN 302 Macroeconomics, Financial Management I (listed as BFIN 301, prereq BACC 205), BMGT 200 Introduction to Management, and BMKA 200 Introduction to Marketing.
review_note: Financial Management I is coded BFIN 301 in this table but BFIN 300 elsewhere in the catalog.

source_quote: * Engineering students may take Engineering Economics instead of Microeconomics
answer: In the Business Administration minor, engineering students may take Engineering Economics instead of Microeconomics/Macroeconomics and Engineering Project Management instead of Introduction to Management; Computer Science students may take Project Management instead of Entrepreneurship.

source_quote: Assess and discuss the requirements needed to launch and succeed in a startup
answer: Business Administration minor objectives: explain core concepts in accounting, economics, finance, management and marketing; use business principles to understand business environments; and assess what is needed to launch and succeed in a startup.

source_quote: This Minor program aims to prepare students for professional certification and/or a career
answer: The HRM minor prepares students for HR certification or careers; it is designed mainly for non-business students (especially humanities, social sciences and languages) but business students may also benefit.

source_quote: Declare a Minor in Human Resources Management by completing the Minor
answer: The HRM minor requires the Minor Declaration Form, approval of the student's college dean and the CBA dean, a minor CGPA of at least 70%, and 18 credits: BHRM 300, BHRM 305, BHRM 350, BHRM 400, BHRM 450 and BMGT 200; at least 6 credits must not count toward the major or another minor.

source_quote: Students majoring in Management already take BMGT 200 and BHRM 300. They may
answer: Management majors already take BMGT 200 and BHRM 300 and need 3 more minor courses (9 credits); other business majors (except BHRM/BMGT) already take BMGT 200 and need 4 more courses (12 credits); one minor course may also count as a major elective.

source_quote: Provide students with the theoretical and educational background needed for
answer: HRM minor goals: understand HRM theories and best practices, apply knowledge to employee relations, and prepare for HR certification or employment; students learn HR skills, HR problem-solving, interpersonal communication and basics of HR strategic planning.
